title: Browse pages, present in blocks
summary: Browse is the default reading view. A slideshow is a block inside the same content tree.

blocks.title: Browse pages, present in blocks
blocks.body: The artifact stays a readable page. Add a slideshow block where the story needs paced presentation.

columns.name: Browse - the default
columns.detail: A normal scrolling page for opening a link, studying, searching, revisiting, and mobile use.

columns.name: Slideshow block - when pacing helps
columns.detail: A block with its own previous, next, and slide controls. It lives alongside the rest of the page instead of changing the whole artifact.

blocks.heading: Five shipped themes
items: Paper - warm, quiet, and suited to long reading.
Signal - crisp green emphasis for clear product communication.
Workshop - practical orange accents and tactile warmth.
Night - dark surfaces with cool, high-contrast type.
Field - muted green tokens for grounded working notes.

blocks.title: The product call is now explicit
blocks.body: Browse is the artifact-wide reading view. Presentation is available as a slideshow block, not as a global mode. Readers can still audition the five shipped themes.

blocks.title: Mode and theme rationale
blocks.body: One content tree feeds a readable page. Slideshow blocks provide paced presentation only where the author asks for it.

blocks.heading: Same file, one page
blocks.body: Presentation belongs inside the content as a block, while the artifact remains easy to read and share.
